urls.description: OpenAI and Anthropic want Britain to make AI safety rules mandatory. At a parliamentary hearing on Tuesday, both companies backed binding requirements, while Google DeepMind and Meta argued for standards and pointed to existing UK regulators. The divide matters because Britain’s current checks on frontier models depend on companies volunteering access—and the government says the system cannot stop a company from releasing a model it considers too dangerous.
